explain.en: Browsers Playwright downloaded for automated tests and AI agents. Tests that use them stop working until you run `npx playwright install` again.
explain.zh: Playwright 为自动化测试和 AI 智能体下载的浏览器。挪走后，用到它们的测试要重新运行 `npx playwright install` 才能再用。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: 1.0G (chromium-1208, chromium_headless_shell-1208, firefox-1509, webkit-2248, ffmpeg-1011). macOS 26.6.2.

notes: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 keeps browsers inside each project's node_modules; those are not scanned. Playwright's own uninstall command is `npx playwright uninstall --all`; it is not offered as official_cleanup because npx can fetch and run any package.
